verdict.rationale: Cline documents that users are 'never locked into our platform or pricing' and can 'switch providers or self-host anytime' (cline-docs-15), plus BYOK/local-model support (cline-docs-27, cline-docs-41, cline-docs-42), which speaks to avoiding lock-in but is not the same as a documented data-export feature. There is no evidence of an explicit export function for task history, conversations, or configs in open formats. missing for 10: explicit data-export/backup feature, documentation of file formats used for stored history, independent confirmation of a 'leave with your data' workflow.
